intro.line: After the Sylex the sun is dim, the Church burns spellcasters, and the old empires starve.

finale.line: I didn't come here to win, wizard. I came to see who was left.
The thrulls of Sarpadia rise against their masters. The empires fall one by one.

battles.title: The Pretender's Inquisition
battles.blurb: After the Sylex, the sun is dim and the Church burns anyone who casts a spell. You cast spells.

scene.line: Magic brought the darkness. Magic will burn for it.
You carry the smell of it. Kneel.
Confess, or be shown.

villainScene.line: The sun went dark because of people like this one.
Burn the magic out and the light comes back. It must.

battles.title: Johan's Crossing
battles.blurb: A merchant prince defends his desert city from a warlord who wants it. Only one of them leaves a legend.

scene.line: Hazezon. Open the gates and I keep your city whole.
My city is my people, Johan. They don't open.
Then they'll be a story. A short one.
Stay close. Stories are how we win here.

villainScene.line: Hazezon talks about his people as if they were walls.
Walls fall. Bring the army forward.

battles.title: The Thallid Grove
battles.blurb: Sarpadia is starving. The elves grow fungus soldiers to survive; the Ebon Hand wants the grove for its thrull pits.

scene.line: We are no longer Nature's children, but her masters.
The magic at the heart of all living things can bear awe-inspiring fruit.
Then we'll harvest it.
The thallids grow faster than you can cut. Watch.

villainScene.line: The elves grow soldiers out of rot. Clever.
The Ebon Hand needs that rot more than they do. Take the grove.

hero.loss: Burn the spores... don't let them have it.

battles.title: Tetsuo's Test
battles.blurb: The last great Umezawa wizard has heard about the rift-walker. He wants to know if you're a weapon or a friend.

scene.line: You came through a rift. So did the thing I'm hunting.
An old dragon. Older than kings. He collects wizards like you.
Show me you can't be collected.

villainScene.line: Every wizard the dragon collected thought they were strong.
Let's see if this one learns faster than they did.

battles.title: The Thrull Rebellion
battles.blurb: The Ebon Hand made their thrulls smart enough to help with the sacrifices. That turned out to be a mistake.

scene.line: Valiant Icatia was the last of the Sarpadian empires to fall.
Not today, though.
Master says: sacrifice. Thrull asks: whose?
...Did that thrull just ask a question?

villainScene.line: Master made thrull to sacrifice others.
Thrull has been thinking. Thrull has a list.

battles.title: The Deck
battles.blurb: An Elder Dragon who believes in order above everything. His deck agrees: counter it, answer it, win slowly. The era's legendary control deck.

scene.line: Chaos has a smell. You reek of it.
I do not attack. I simply wait until everything you do has failed.
Begin. Or don't. The result is the same.

villainScene.line: Order is not cruelty. It is patience.
Let them cast. Every spell they waste brings the end closer.

battles.title: Hymn to Tourach
battles.blurb: The Ebon Hand's choir sings a hymn that drives warriors mad. The era's discard deck.

scene.line: Tourach... Tourach...
Cover your ears. Don't think about what you're holding.
The eerie, wailing Hymn caused insanity even in hardened warriors.

villainScene.line: Sing louder, sisters. The warriors are listening.
Tourach... Tourach... let them forget what they hold.

battles.title: The Last Elder Dragon
battles.blurb: Under the Wastes, the thing Tetsuo has hunted his whole life opens one eye.

scene.line: An Umezawa. Your grandfather made that face too.
You're shorter than the legends said.
The legends were written by survivors. There aren't many.
And you. The little rift-walker. I've been waiting a long time to meet one of you.
Don't talk to him. Don't bargain. Just fight.

villainScene.line: Every hero in this age will die. I simply want to watch how.

villain.win: Another Umezawa. I'll add you to the shelf.
villain.loss: Keep this victory. I have time.
